title: Long Multiplication Visualizer
description: Multiply two numbers showing every partial product with its place-value shift, then the sum.
howto: Press Multiply to see the column method.
Each partial product shows its place-value shift before they are added.

faqs.q: Why do some rows have extra zeros?
faqs.a: Multiplying by the tens digit means multiplying by tens, so the partial product is shifted one place left — that is the extra zero.
Yes, the sign is applied to the final product after the partial products are computed.
Whole numbers only, so every partial product is exact. Multiply decimals separately after scaling them up.
